methodology_reference: Rare Tape valuation methodology v1.0 / handbags_v1

subject_asset_summary.note: Rally identifies the subject as a 2015 Hermès 35cm Bordeaux Crocodile Birkin. Rally lists dimensions as 19 x 27 x 35 cm.

market_context.overview: The subject belongs to the exotic-skin Birkin 35 market. Exact Bordeaux, shiny Porosus, 35cm examples are comparatively scarce in publicly accessible completed-auction records.
market_context.collector_demand: Porosus crocodile, shiny finish, Bordeaux coloration and gold hardware create a highly specific collector configuration. Size, color, crocodile species, finish, hardware, condition and accessory completeness are relevant valuation variables.
market_context.regulatory_context: Porosus crocodile is CITES-regulated. Auction houses warn that export and import restrictions may materially constrain cross-border transfer and therefore liquidity.

comparable_selection_policy.primary_target: Completed Hermès Birkin 35 auction sales prioritizing shiny Bordeaux Porosus crocodile with gold hardware.
priority_order: Bordeaux or closely related red/burgundy color
exclude_from_official_valuation: Birkin 25 or Birkin 30 unless used only as market context
Alligator or Niloticus comparables where better Porosus evidence exists

strengths: One verified completed sale closely matches model, size, Bordeaux color, shiny Porosus material and gold hardware.
A second completed Bordeaux Porosus Birkin 35 sale provides additional exact-color evidence.
Several additional completed Porosus Birkin 35 sales provide broader exotic Birkin price anchors.
weaknesses: The strongest exact comparable is materially older than the 2015 subject.
Several comparable sales require FX normalization.
Buyer-premium treatment is not normalized across every source.

supports: 2026 market evidence for Bordeaux shiny Porosus Birkin 35

observations: Porosus crocodile is a premium exotic Hermès material.
Bordeaux is a distinctive deep-red Hermès color.
Shiny finish materially differentiates the subject from matte crocodile examples.
Gold hardware is an exact-match factor for the subject.
Birkin 35 has renewed market relevance but size preference can vary over time.
Exact Bordeaux Porosus Birkin 35 completed sales are relatively sparse.
CITES restrictions can constrain cross-border buyer pools and shipment.
Fractional Rally liquidity may differ substantially from whole-bag auction liquidity.

legal_regulatory_considerations: Cross-border shipment may require permits or may be prohibited depending on jurisdiction and documentation.
Regulatory restrictions can affect liquidity and realizable value.

observations: Exact 35cm + Bordeaux + shiny Porosus + gold-hardware configurations are uncommon in accessible auction records.
Production year and condition further reduce truly comparable supply.
Exotic Hermès bags have materially smaller comparable sets than standard leather Birkins.

valuation_adjustment_questions: What is the subject's current condition grade?
Are there scratches, glazing wear, scale lifting or loss of shine?
What is the condition of the gold hardware?
Are lock, keys, clochette, exotic leather card, dust bags, box and ribbon still present?
Does Rally retain relevant CITES documentation?
Should historical GBP transactions use sale-date FX rather than the engine's configured static GBP rate?
Should sale_year be incorporated into recency weighting when an exact sale_date is unavailable?

assumptions: Subject is the authentic 2015 Hermès Birkin 35 represented by Rally.
Subject material is shiny Porosus crocodile.
Listed Rally accessories are assumed present unless later evidence shows otherwise.
No condition premium or discount is assigned without a current condition report.
Auction estimates and dealer asking prices are excluded from official completed-sale comparables.

research_limitations: Current Rally share price and market value were not supplied.
Some auction records expose only sale year rather than an exact sale date.
Historical FX conversion is delegated to the valuation engine where USD-at-sale values are unavailable.
Buyer-premium treatment is not fully normalized across all comparables.
Several close Bordeaux auction lots expose estimates but not realized prices.
analyst_notes: The 2008 Christie's Bordeaux Porosus Birkin 35 with gold hardware is the strongest completed identity match located.
The Fellows 2006 Bordeaux Porosus Birkin 35 provides a second exact-color/material/size anchor but with less complete configuration data.
Rouge H and Miel Porosus Birkin 35 transactions are included as secondary market anchors rather than exact-color comparables.
Final comparable weights should be determined by the valuation engine.
